nimble: Soft, round, ash-gray, dark violet, purple peas--peas Alfie and Ona and Din and Mirrie ate raw; grown by her own nimble, prolific hands.

Among the giant fossils of my past,
Like some small nimble mouse between the ribs
Of a mastodon, I nibbled here and there
And although it was impossible for Marie to be other than deft, nimble and silent, what heart could she have in ministering to that most uninspiring of spectacles—three ladies dining alone?
Harling sceptically, as she took up her crocheting again and sent the hook in and out with nimble fingers.

Bare hands to touch, the sparrow’s cheep
To heed, and watch his nimble flight
Above the short brown grass asleep.
